Conversion/replacement?.note: Montana-Dakota's application to the North Dakota Public Service Commission in case PU-19-307 says Heskett 4 will be used after the retirement of the Heskett 1 and Heskett 2 coal units. So the unit replaced coal units 1 and 2.

units.notes: EIA lists 88.4 MW against GEM's 88.0 MW. The difference is within rounding, so capacity stays as it is.

Owner(s).note: Montana-Dakota's application in case PU-19-307 asks to own and operate Heskett 4 and calls Heskett Unit 3 its own unit. The commission order in case PU-25-280 from February 2026 also names Montana-Dakota Utilities Co. as the owner of the Heskett units 1 and 2 assets. Both units 3 and 4 are therefore owned by Montana-Dakota. The value matches GEM.

qa.question: Which unit did Heskett unit 4 replace?
qa.finding: The Montana-Dakota application in case PU-19-307 (https://www.psc.nd.gov/webdocs/case/19-0307/001-010.pdf) says Heskett 4 serves customers after the retirement of the coal units Heskett 1 and Heskett 2. A February 2026 commission order in case PU-25-280 (https://www.psc.nd.gov/webdocs/case/25-0280/013-010.pdf) confirms those two units are retired.
qa.recommendation: Link Heskett unit 4 to GEM unit G100000103860 (Heskett Unit 1) and G100000103861 (Heskett Unit 2), replacing the link to ID 0. If only one link is allowed, use G100000103861.
qa.note: The same application also names Lewis and Clark 1 in Montana as retired for the same need. That plant is not part of this one.

qa.question: What document gives the Heskett owner that the validation report found unsourced?
qa.finding: Case PU-19-307 (https://www.psc.nd.gov/webdocs/case/19-0307/001-010.pdf) shows Montana-Dakota Utilities owns the Heskett site and Heskett Unit 3. It states no other owner.
qa.recommendation: Add the commission filing in case PU-19-307 as the Owners Data Source and leave the value as is.
qa.note: The September 2026 EIA-860M table lists Montana-Dakota Utilities Co. as the plant's entity.

qa.question: Should the possible Heskett combined cycle conversion be tracked?
qa.finding: Montana-Dakota's 2024 North Dakota resource plan, volume IV (https://www.montana-dakota.com/wp-content/uploads/PDFs/Rates-Tariffs/2024-ND-IRP-Vol-4_nonprint.pdf), lists a 329.7 MW expansion of Heskett 3 and 4 to combined cycle among the least-cost options in some scenarios. The base plan only completes Heskett 4 in 2024.
qa.recommendation: Do not add anything. Check the next resource plan for a committed combined cycle.
qa.note: I found no commission case for it. The queue entries J1193 and R1000 are the earlier requests for unit 4.
